title: Extract the label to be collected from the package object
goal: Select records that meet the conditions from the object array, and then read the specified attributes of each record.
summary: pick-up screen only displays prepared package labels. Each package record also saves the label and stocking status.
tasks: complete listReadyPickups(parcels). Each record has a string label and a Boolean value ready.
Find the records whose ready is true and return a string array composed of labels of these records.
retains the original order and duplicate labels. Returns an empty array when there are no ready packages.

example.note: First use the confirmed field of the object to filter out the confirmed activities, and then use map to extract the names of these activities.

hint: filtering is completed, there are still complete objects in the array. Then get the label of each object to get the string array needed for the pick-up screen.
